Anthropization.subject: International Relations
Anthropization.question: What is Anthropization? Conversion of natural environments by human action.
Anthropization.fact: In geography and ecology, anthropization is the conversion of open spaces, landscapes, and natural environments by human action.

Anti-aircraft warfare.question: What is Anti-aircraft warfare? Measures to combat enemy aerial forces.
Anti-aircraft warfare.fact: Anti-aircraft warfare (AAW) or air defence (air defense in American English) is the counter to aerial warfare and includes "all measures designed to nullify or reduce the effectiveness of hostile air action".

Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty.subject: International Relations
Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty.question: The _____ was 1972 arms control treaty between the United States and the Soviet Union.
Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty.fact: The Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty, also called the ABM Treaty or ABMT, was a 1972 arms control treaty between the United States and the Soviet Union on the limitation of the anti-ballistic missile (ABM) systems used in defending areas against strategic ballistic missiles, which are used to deliver nuclear weapons It was intended to reduce pressures to build more nuclear weapons to maintain deterrence.
